own_solution.law: Two-step Doppler: f2 = f (c - w)(c - v)/(c (c + w)); shift f - f2
assumptions: recorder moves with the reflected sound

defect_reasons.other: The scene_clause_note refers to 'a belt that moves' the toolbox, which appears nowhere in the item (the sentences use a walking technician); a stale explanatory note that does not affect any answer or stratum.

notes: Verified: base 1500 x (1 - 112558/119707) = 89.581 Hz; recorder speed 10.1 -> 94.226, 10.6 -> 96.338, 11.4 -> 99.716 Hz. The crest-timing cancellation for the initial distance is correct: t_h = (q + c t)/(c - w), T = (q + (c + w) t_h)/(c - v), so T_(n+1) - T_n = c(c + w)/(f (c - w)(c - v)) and q cancels. In pass 1 I labelled the 82 m sentences D because they enter no steady-state Doppler relation; given the authors' crest-timing relations, in which the distance does appear and cancels, C is a defensible label, and the answer is the same either way. Minimal pairs T02E2/TBF04 and T4BE2/TA0C8 share 1.6 m/s and differ only in time or in what is carried; numeral-free twins match.
